mapper.select: SELECT p.*,t.status AS task_status,t.error AS task_error FROM plan_changes p LEFT JOIN tasks t ON t.id=p.task_id WHERE p.novel_id=#{args[0]} ORDER BY p.created_at DESC,p.id DESC
SELECT id FROM tasks WHERE novel_id=#{args[0]} AND (status IN ('RUNNING','READY') OR (kind='PLAN_CHANGE' AND status='WAITING'))
mapper.update: UPDATE plan_changes SET suggestion=#{args[0]},task_id=#{args[1]},status='PENDING' WHERE id=#{args[2]} AND status='GENERATING'
UPDATE plan_changes SET task_id=#{args[0]} WHERE id=#{args[1]} AND status='GENERATING'
UPDATE plan_changes SET status='APPLIED',applied_plan=#{args[0]},applied_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{args[1]} AND status='PENDING'
